factors.name: nvda_cum5_minus_aapl_cum5
factors.hypothesis: Short-horizon relative strength of NVDA vs AAPL signals mean reversion or catch-up in AAPL.

factors.name: nvda_volume_zscore_5d_change
factors.hypothesis: Abnormal NVDA volume reflects tech-sector risk events that spill over to AAPL's next day.

factors.name: msft_return_1d_minus_aapl_return_1d
factors.hypothesis: If MSFT outperformed AAPL today, AAPL may catch up (lead-lag) tomorrow.

factors.name: qqq_volatility_10d
factors.hypothesis: Market-wide volatility regime affects the next-day up-probability and risk premium for AAPL.

factors.name: nvda_range_vs_aapl_range
factors.formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(NVDA_High, NVDA_Low), NVDA_Close), safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), AAPL_Close))
factors.hypothesis: Relative intraday turbulence in NVDA versus AAPL captures sector stress that AAPL has yet to absorb.

factors.name: qqq_volume_zscore_20
factors.hypothesis: Unusual market-wide volume marks capitulation or panic days, followed by rebounds.
